entries.zh: 径自去做；不待上级之命而擅自行事（径行自专）
entries.en: to act by one's own will without leave of one's superior; to do presumptuously, on one's own authority

entries.zh: 做、造；开始制作、始造（创始）
entries.en: to make or create; to begin making, commence, originate

entries.zh: 采摘、摘取；采取、选用
entries.en: to pick or gather; to take, select (Spanish headword abbreviated, expansion uncertain)
entries.notes: 西语词头「caps.」为缩写、展开未定；闽南语栏后段残损，采摘义由汉字栏「采」确定。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕中：居间/命中之义无法定夺
entries.en: 〔damaged in the original, gloss uncertain〕; sense (to hit / to act as middleman) unresolved
entries.notes: 西语词头于缩写「caps」后残断、展开未解；汉字「中」多义，四栏互证不足。

entries.zh: 照（样式）做；仿照、依样制作
entries.en: to make according to another model or pattern; to copy after an example

entries.zh: 骂詈秽语：奸你母（咒诅人母，极秽之词）；西语栏注「对你之妻妇」（a tu muger）
entries.en: gross obscenity uttered as a curse: 'to fornicate with your mother'; noted 'against your woman/wife' (a tu muger)
entries.notes: 汉字栏第二字存疑（疑为「森」）；西语「glo」疑为讹字或缩写；秽骂义由西语与闽南语原稿互证明确。

entries.zh: 〔缩写未解，释义存疑〕张：与「做淫」秽义之对应无法定夺
entries.en: 〔abbreviation unresolved, gloss uncertain〕 to cause fornication; correspondence with the Chinese headword unclear
entries.notes: 西语末尾缩写「tº」无法展开；闽南语栏为括注读音，汉字「张」与句义难以互证。

entries.zh: 请（神父）行告解；认罪、办告解（天主教告解圣事）
entries.en: to make one's confession; to request confession (of sins) from a priest

entries.zh: 重新制作；创制、创造（创新、改造）
entries.en: to make anew, create afresh; to originate, renovate

entries.zh: 耕种、耕田（做田）；下种耕作
entries.en: to till or farm, make a sowing; to cultivate the land

entries.zh: 自创、自制；自己置办（不假手于人）
entries.en: to make or acquire by oneself; to create or procure for oneself

entries.zh: 搭盖、搭建（如搭寮搭棚，似起造屋宇）
entries.en: to put up, erect (as building a hut or shed); to construct

entries.zh: 重做；再做一遍（因需要而重做）
entries.en: to redo, make again (as need requires)
entries.notes: 西语词头截断于「neces~」（疑为 necessidad），展开依赖推断；重做义由汉字栏与闽南语栏明确。

entries.zh: 任凭、听任；任其选择（由人自择而为）
entries.en: to allow or let another choose and act at will; to permit, yield the choice

entries.zh: 引导、教导；示范、垂范（以为榜样）
entries.en: to guide or lead; to set an example, lead by example

entries.zh: 使坚固、做牢固（做得结实稳固）
entries.en: to make firm or solid; to make well-built, firm
entries.notes: 闽南语栏声调号污损难辨；西语「bienhechos」疑为 bien hechos（做得牢固）之连写，坚固义明确。

entries.zh: 酿造、酿酒（酿制酒类）
entries.en: to brew, ferment; to make wine

entries.zh: 索取、索求；图利而为（或指索讨利息、债款）
entries.en: to demand or exact for gain; to do for profit or interest
entries.notes: 「hazer por interés」与汉字「索」的对应依赖推断（或指索讨利息债款）；闽南语栏声调号污损难辨。

entries.zh: 耽误、误事；妨害、把事办坏
entries.en: to spoil or botch the work; to hinder, delay, cause error

entries.zh: 变化、化成；奇迹般地变化（神迹变化）
entries.en: to transform or change; to do (something) miraculously, work a miraculous change

entries.zh: 施舍、布施；施恩、给予恩惠
entries.en: to bestow, give alms or favors; to show grace or bounty

entries.zh: 〔语义无法定夺，释义存疑〕汉字疑为「恶」；加害、损害之义待考
entries.en: to do harm, damage, injure (Chinese correspondence unresolved; Mandarin column note 'error of love' obscure)
entries.notes: 汉字栏「宪」存疑（疑为「恶」）；闽南语原稿音写与汉字栏读音不合；官话栏注文「error de el amor」语义费解，无法互证。
